obligations.title: Tax collection at source
obligations.description: Collect & pay to the government, within 1 week from the last day of the month in which tax is collected at the prescribed rate from the buyer engaged in business
obligations.applicabilityText: Every seller of scrap at the time of debiting the amount payable or receiving payment

obligations.title: Payment of house rent allowance
obligations.description:
1. Pay to every workman house rent allowance at the rate of 5% of the wages payable during a month or Rs. 15, whichever is higher, within 10 days of the following month.

2. Deduct house rent allowance from the salary of employee who has been provided house accommodation.

3. For a workman employed purely on temporary basis or casual basis or as a badli, who renders service for less than 6 days in a month, pay house-rent allowance on prorata basis.
obligations.applicabilityText: Every employer of industry in which 50 or more workmen are employed

obligations.title: Deposit of fines and unpaid accumulations
obligations.description:
1. Pay all fines realised from the employees and all unpaid accumulations during the quarters, ending the 31st March, the 30th June, the 30th September and the 31st December to the Welfare Commissioner, within 15 days from the closure of each quarter.

2. Submit a statement to the Welfare Commissioner giving full particulars of the amounts so paid along with the payment.

obligations.title: Payment of Contribution to ESI Corporation (For Contractors)
obligations.description: Pay both employer's contribution and employee's contribution to the ESI Corporation in respect of every employee who earns wages of Rs. 21,000 or less (For Contractors)

obligations.title: Submission of Annual Return
obligations.description: File a Unified Annual Return online in Form XIV annexed to the Rationalisation of Forms and Reports under Certain Labour Laws Rules, 2017, on the Shram Suvidha Portal of the Central Government in the Ministry of Labour and Employment on or before the 1st day of February following the end of the year to which it relates.

obligations.title: Submission of quarterly return to the local employment exchange
obligations.description: Furnish quarterly returns to the Local Employment Exchange in Form ER I by 30 April, 30 July, 30 October and 30 January
obligations.applicabilityText: Every establishment employing 25 or more persons

obligations.title: Submission of annual return for bonus to the authority
obligations.description: Upload a unified annual return, on the web portal of the Central Government in the  Ministry of Labour and Employment, in Form D, on or before 1st of February in each year, giving information about particulars regarding preceding year.

obligations.title: Responsibility of waste generator
obligations.description: Ensure that the actions specified in the log sheet attached are to be followed

obligations.title: Deposition of Tax Deducted at Source, when the amount was deducted other than in March
obligations.description: Submit the tax amount before 7th of the month, immediately following the month in which tax was deducted.
obligations.applicabilityText: Person deducting Tax at Source from Salary

obligations.title: Maintenance of noise levels  for different areas/zones
obligations.description: Maintain noise levels as per the standards specified in the Schedule.

obligations.title: Medical Examination of Workers employed in Hazardous Process
obligations.description:
Get the workers medically examined once before employment and thereafter once in a period of six months to ascertain the health status of all the workers in respect of occupational health hazards to which they are exposed and ensure that worker obtains certificate of fitness in Form 25

Record the medical examinations carried out in the Health Register in Form 17.
obligations.applicabilityText: Every occupier of factory carrying on a hazardous process

obligations.title: Collection of TCS on sale of motor vehicle
obligations.description: Ensure TCS @ 1% of sale consideration at the time of receipt of such amount to be collected from the buyer
obligations.applicabilityText: Every person, being a seller of motor vehicle exceeding Rs. 10 lac

obligations.title: Deduction, Fine, Damage, Loss, Advance
obligations.description: Ensure that the deduction, fine, damage, loss and advances are made to the employees as per the attachment.
obligations.applicabilityText: Every person responsible for payment of wages

obligations.title: Annealing of all chains and lifting tackle used in connection with molten metal slag
obligations.description: Get all chains, slings, rings, hooks, shackles and swivels used in connection with molten metal slag or when they are made of half inch bar or smaller, annealed by a competent person at least once in every six months.

obligations.title: Location of pressure vessels
obligations.description: Ensure that each vessel is located with respect to the nearest building or group of buildings or line of adjoining property which may be built on and with respect to other vessel; and facilities in accordance with the distances specified in the attached log sheet "Tables"
obligations.applicabilityText: Every person in charge of vessels meant for storage

obligations.title: Employee protection against diseases
obligations.description:
Take the following health and safety measures to ensure occupational safety of the employee:
1. Immunise all the health care workers and others, involved in handling of bio-medical waste for protection against diseases including Hepatitis B and Tetanus that are likely to be transmitted by handling of bio-medical waste, in the manner as prescribed in the National Immunisation Policy or the guidelines of the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare issued from time to time; and
2. Provide appropriate and adequate personal protective equipments
obligations.applicabilityText:
Every:
1. Occupier; or
2. Operator of a common bio-medical waste treatment and disposal facility

obligations.title: Examination of eye-sight of certain workers
obligations.description: Get the eye-sight and colour vision of the person employed examined at least once in every period of twelve months upto the age of forty-five years and once in every six months beyond that age.
obligations.applicabilityText: Every occupier of factory employing persons to operate a crane, locomotive, fork-lift truck, dumper, dozer, lorry, tractor, etc. or to give signals to a crane or locomotive operator

obligations.title: Precautions to be observed in carrying out the periodic testing
Standard of accessibility
Explosive or inflammable dust, gas, etc.
obligations.applicabilityText: Factory in which any manufacturing process produces dust, gas, fume or vapour of such character and to such extent as to be likely to explode on ignition

obligations.title: No discrimination on the ground of disability
obligations.description: Ensure that no person with disability shall be discriminated on the ground of disability or denied any right or benefit, unless it is shown that the impugned act or omission is a proportionate means of achieving a legitimate aim.

obligations.title: Transfer of gas for filling/discharging on vehicles
obligations.description: Ensure to carry out the transfer of gas for filling/discharging as per the attached log sheet " Transfer operations"
obligations.applicabilityText: Every person incharge of transfer of gas to vehicles

obligations.title: Payment of user fee
obligations.description: Pay such user fee for solid waste management as specified in the bye-laws of the local bodies.

obligations.title: Markings of pressure vessels
Paintings of pressure vessels
obligations.description: Ensure that the above ground vessel is adequately painted externally to prevent corrosion and has a reflecting surface.

obligations.title: Payment for overtime - Minimum wages
obligations.description: Pay overtime wages (in case of employee whose minimum wage rate is fixed by the hour/day/longer period, and the employee works more than the normal working hours)
obligations.applicabilityText: Every employer requiring employees to work overtime

obligations.title: Transport of gas by vehicles - Operations
obligations.description:
Ensure the following:
(1) Driver shall be carefully selected and given appropriate training in driving and safe handling of the equipment and the compressed gas carried in the vehicle.
(2) When loading or discharging of a vehicle takes place within the operator s own premises, a skilled and trained person with requisite knowledge and experience shall be present throughout the operations.
(3) When discharge is in progress, at customers premises, the driver shall remain with his vehicle in such a position so as to be able to stop the discharge immediately in an emergency.
(4) Every vehicle shall be constantly attended to by at least one person who is familiar with these rules except vehicles which are left in places previously approved for the purpose by the Chief Controller;
(5) In the event of an over-night stop away from home base, prior arrangements shall be made for the safe parking of the vehicle overnight. In an emergency, a driver may seek the co-operation of the local police in finding suitable parking facilities for his vehicle.
obligations.applicabilityText: Every person in case of transporting of any compressed gas

obligations.title: Restriction on filling, manufacture and import of pressure vessels including fittings and vaporiser
obligations.description:
1. Ensure not to fill any compressed gas in any vessel or transport any vessel filled with any compressed gas unless such vessel has been manufactured in accordance with a type or standard or code duly approved by the Chief Controller.

2. Ensure to manufacture the vessels and fittings including vaporiser with the prior approval of the Chief Controller.
obligations.applicabilityText: Every person filling any compressed gas in an vessel, or transporting any vessel filled with any compressed gas, or any factory involved in the manufacture of vessels

obligations.title: Standards for emissions or discharge of environment pollutants
obligations.description: Ensure that the standards for emission or discharge of environmental pollutants from the industries, operations or processes shall be as specified in Schedule I to IV
obligations.applicabilityText: Any person discharging environmental pollutants in an area, from industries, operations, process, automobiles and domestic sources

obligations.title: Requirements maintenance of storage facilities of petroleum class A/B/C
obligations.description: Comply with the general requirements including safety pertaining to the maintenance of petroleum Class A/B/C  storage facilities as referred in the log sheet.
obligations.applicabilityText: Every person using petroleum of Class A/B/C and the person in charge for storage shed area/service station/installation

logSheets.label: Installations Class A,B & C- General Requirements.xlsx

obligations.title: First Aid
obligations.description: Provide first aid boxes distinctively marked with a red cross on white background containing equipment as mentioned in additional information column.

obligations.title: Responsibility of waste generator
obligations.description: Ensure to follow the actions as specified in the log sheet

obligations.title: Loading and unloading facilities for pressure vessels
obligations.description: Ensure to provide the loading and unloading facilities for the pressure vessels as per the attached log sheet "Loading and unloading facilities"

obligations.title: Packaging and Labelling of hazardous and other Wastes as per Form 8
obligations.description:
Ensure that the hazardous and other wastes are packaged in a manner suitable for safe handling, storage and transport as per the guidelines issued by the Central Pollution Control Board from time to time. The labelling shall be done as per Form 8.
The label shall be of non-washable material, weather proof and easily visible.

obligations.title: Prohibition of employment of children and intoxicated persons.
obligations.description: Ensure no person under the age of eighteen years or who is in a state of intoxication shall be employed for the loading, unloading or transport of any vessel containing compressed gas, or in any licensed premises.

obligations.title: Protection of valves and accessories
obligations.description:
Ensure the following:

1. All valves and accessories are safeguarded against accidental damage interference.
2. Valves and accessories are mounted and protected in such a way that risks of accidental rupture of the branch to which the valve or accessory is connected is minimised.
3. Valves or accessories situated at the rear of a vehicle are protected by the rear cross member of the frame of the vehicle against and shall comply with sub – rule (2) above.
obligations.applicabilityText: Every person involved in designing or constructing or testing of valves/ accessories

obligations.title: Repair and modification to pressure vessels
obligations.description:
(1) Ensure not to carry out any repairs or modifications to any vessel unless the prior approval of repairs or modifications, procedure and their method of execution is obtained from the Chief Controller or Controller authorised by him on payment of a scrutiny fee of rupees 2500/-. 

(2) Ensure to carry out the repairs and modifications in the manner and by practices acceptable under the design code including Non Destructive Testing (NDT) methods and pressure testing under stage wise inspection of inspector recognised by the Chief Controller.

(3) Ensure that before any repairs, additions or alterations are carried out to any vessel, the same shall be completely emptied and purged with an inert gas.

(4) Maintain complete record of repairs, additions or alterations and make it  available to the Chief Controller or Controller authorized by him and obtain his permission before re-commissioning of the vessel.
obligations.applicabilityText: Every person carrying out the repairs and modifications to any vessel

obligations.title: Courses of related training
obligations.description: Ensure that a course of related instructions (which shall be appropriate to the trade and approved by the Central Govt.) is given to every Trade apprentice undergoing practical training with a view to giving him such theoretical knowledge as he needs in order to become fully qualified as a skilled craftsman.
obligations.applicabilityText: Every employer on engaging Trade apprentice

obligations.title: Shelters, rest-rooms and lunch-rooms
obligations.description: Provide and maintain  adequate and suitable shelters or rest-rooms and a suitable lunch-room, as per additional information column.
obligations.applicabilityText: Every occupier of factory  wherein more than one hundred and fifty workers are ordinarily employed

obligations.title: Record of White Washing
obligations.description:
Paint or varnish the areas of the factory premise as per the specification given in the additional information

Maintain a register in Form No. 6, to keep the record of dates on which white-washing, colour washing, varnishing, etc., are carried out.

obligations.title: Periodic testing of pressure vessels in service
obligations.description: Ensure that the pressure vessels are tested hydraulically by a competent person Third party inspection agency (TPIA) at a pressure marked on the vessel at intervals of not more than after five years after the date of first test, provided that in case of vessels containing corrosive and toxic gases, the periodic test shall be done at an interval of two years.

obligations.title: Provide policy for privacy and disclosure of information
obligations.description: Provide a privacy policy for handling of or dealing in personal information  and ensure that the same are available for view by such providers of information who has provided such information under lawful contract
obligations.applicabilityText: Every Body Corporate or any person who on behalf of body corporate collects, receives, possess, stores, deals or handle information of provider of information

obligations.title: Provision of latrines and urinals facility
obligations.description: Ensure that the latrine and urinal facilities are extended to contract workers as prescribed in the log sheet attached.

obligations.title: Pits, sumps openings in floors, etc.
obligations.description: Ensure that every fixed vessel, sump, tank, pit or opening in the ground or in a floor which, by reason of its depth, situation, construction or contents, is or may be a source of danger, shall be either securely covered or securely fenced.

obligations.title: Examination of hoist and Lifts
obligations.description: Ensure that every hoist and lifts are thoroughly examined by a competent person at least once in every period of six months

obligations.title: Safety data sheet
obligations.description:
Compile safety data sheet as per Schedule 9.
 The information in safety data sheet shall be accessible upon request for reference

 If any significant information regarding hazard of a chemical is available, it shall be added to the material safety data sheet as specified in Schedule 9 as soon as practicable
obligations.applicabilityText: Every Occupier to an industrial activity in which a hazardous chemical which satisfies any of the criteria laid down in Part I of Schedule I or listed in Column 2 of Part II of this Schedule is or may be involved

obligations.title: Development and organization of safety training programmes
obligations.description: Ensure the safety officer shall develop and organize safety training programmes at regular intervals in order to impart proper safety training and shall also create safety awareness among the employees
obligations.applicabilityText: Every owner who owns or operates or maintains electrical plants or electric lines

obligations.title: Submission of Annual Report to the Authority
obligations.description: Submit an Annual Report to the prescribed authority in Form-IV, on or before the 30th June of every year
obligations.applicabilityText: Every:1. Occupier; or2. Operator of a common bio-medical waste treatment and disposal facility

obligations.title: Implementation of security practices and standards
obligations.description:
Implement such security practices and standards and have a comprehensive documented information security programme and information security policies that contain managerial, technical, operational and physical security control measures that are commensurate with the information assets being protected with the nature of business.
Further, audit of aforesaid reasonable security practices and procedures shall be carried out by an auditor at least once a year or as and when the body corporate or a person on its behalf undertake significant upgradation of its process and computer resource.
obligations.applicabilityText: Every body corporate or a person

obligations.title: Renewal of Consent
obligations.description: Application to be submitted 120 days prior to expiry

obligations.title: Electrical apparatus and installations
obligations.description:
Ensure that:

(1) no electrical wire pass over any storage vessel. 

(2) all electrical wires installed within the safety zone of any storage vessel for the storage of flammable compressed gases shall consist of insulated cables of approved type which shall be mechanically continuous throughout and effectively earthed away from the vessels.

(3) For pump rooms used for pumping flammable compressed gases:
(i) all electrical motors, distribution boards, switches, fuses, plugs, sockets and other instrumentation shall be of explosion protection construction complying with the requirements of IS TEC 60079-1 to 11 as amended from time to time and the Games shall be effectively earthed;
(ii) all electrical fixed lamps shall be enclosed in a well glass flameproof fitting conforming to IS TEC 60079-1 amended from time to time.

(4) All electrical portable hand lamps and other instrumentation shall be of a type approved by the Chief Controller.

(5) Vaporisers for liquefiable gases shall be indirect heating type or atmospheric heating type. The vaporizers for flammable, toxic and corrosive gases shall be of a type approved by the Chief Controller.
obligations.applicabilityText: Every persons incharge of storage vessels

obligations.title: Standard of educational qualification for apprentices
obligations.description:
Ensure that the apprentices engaged qualify atleast the minimum standard of educational qualification:

(1) A person shall be eligible for being engaged as a trade apprentice if he satisfies the minimum educational qualifications as specified in Schedule 1.

(2) A person shall be eligible for being engaged as a graduate or technician or technician vocational apprentice if he satisfies one of the minimum educational quali­fications specified in Schedule 1A.

(Please refer log sheet - Schedule 1 and Schedule 1A)

obligations.title: Safety measures for eyes
obligations.description: Provide effective screens or goggles to protect workers employed in or in the immediate vicinity of the processes mentioned
obligations.applicabilityText: Every occupier of the Factory on employing person in the immediate vicinity of the processes specified in Schedule I or II which cause damage to the eyes

obligations.title: Protection against fire
obligations.description:
Ensure the following:

(1)Two serviceable fire extinguishers of suitable size and type shall be provided on each vehicle, one on each side and should be accessible from outside the cab.
(2) A person, while in or attending, any vehicle conveying flammable gas shall not smoke or use matches or lighters.
(3) No fire, artificial light or article capable of causing fire or explosion shall be taken or carried on any vehicle carrying flammable gas.
obligations.applicabilityText: Every person in case of transporting of any compressed gas

obligations.title: Cleanliness and restriction of unauthorised person
obligations.applicabilityText: Every person incharge of vessels meant for storage

obligations.title: Validity of Factory License
obligations.description: Obtain the initial approvals and licenses for setting up a factory and apply for renewal before expiry date.

obligations.title: Collection of Information
obligations.description: Obtain consent in writing through letter or fax or email from the provider of the sensitive personal data or information regarding purpose of usage before collection of such information and take reasonable steps as mentioned in the reference template column.
obligations.applicabilityText: Every Body Corporate or any person who on behalf of body corporate collects, receives, possess, stores, deals or handle information of provider of information

obligations.title: Design code and pressure
obligations.description:
1. Ensure that the vessels are  designed, constructed and tested in accordance with the Indian standard 2825, ASME Section Mil Division 1 or Division 2. PD5500. EN 13458. EN 13530. AD:2000 code as amended from time to time or such other standard or code approved by the chief controller.

2. Ensure that the design pressure of vessel is not less than: -

(a). The vapour pressure of the gas in the vessel at 55dc if the vessel is meant for the storage of liquefiable gases, (Provided that if the vessel is insulated the vapour pressure of the gas in the vessel shall correspond to the maximum temperature that is likely to be attained by the gas in the vessel);
(b). The developed pressure of the gas in the vessel at 55dc if the vessel is meant for the storage of a permanent gas.

(c) the maximum allowable service pressure with additional allowances for vacuum and static head or surge due to acceleration or deceleration, as the case may be. in respect of the cryogenic liquid proposed to be stored or transported.

Ensure that: 
(i) The static head (higher of the water column or the compressed gas column) is  considered for static pressure vessels.
(ii) The wind load, seismic loads is considered for vertical cylindrical vessels and horton spheres.
obligations.applicabilityText: Every person involved in designing, constructing or testing of pressure vessels

obligations.title: Special precautions against accidents
obligations.description: Ensure not to commit or attempt to commit any act which may tend to cause a fire or explosion in or about any place where any compressed gas is stored, handled or transported in vessel.
obligations.applicabilityText: Everyone working in the premise where compressed gases are stored or used

obligations.title: Issuance of certificate to the contractor
obligations.description:
Issue Form V  to the Contractor stating that the contractor has been employed by him as a contractor in relation to his establishment.

Ensure that the contractor :-
(a) Obtains and possesses a valid licence
(b) Complies with the condition of license
obligations.applicabilityText: Every principal employer (in case contractor has more than 10 contract workers)

obligations.title: Protective equipments
obligations.description: Provide personnel protective equipments to workers as required under the act or the rules made thereunder and they shall have certification by Indian Standard Institution and be maintained in good repair and usable condition.

obligations.title: Safe use of Jib Cranes
obligations.description:
Ensure that every jib-crane so constructed that the safe working load may be varied by the raising or lowering of the jib, shall have 
(I) an automatic indicator of safe working loads or an automatic jib angle indicator, and
(ii) a table indicating the safe working loads at corresponding inclination of the job or corresponding radii of the load
obligations.applicabilityText: Every occupier of a factory having Jib Cranes

obligations.title: Precautions against dangerous fumes, gases, etc.
obligations.description:
No person shall be required or allowed to enter any confined space ,pit, vat, tank, pipe, flue until all practicable measures have been taken to remove any gas, fume, vapour or dust, which may be present so as to bring its level within the permissible limits and to prevent any ingress of such g as , fume, vapour or dust and unless--
(a) a certificate in writing has been given by a competent person, based on a  test carried out by himself that the space is reasonably free from dangerous gas , fume, vapour or dust ; or

(b) such person is wearing suitable breathing apparatus and a belt securely attached to a rope the free end of which is held by a person outside the confined space.

obligations.title: Audit of canteen books
obligations.description: Accounts pertaining to the canteens shall be audited once every 12 months by registered accountants and auditors.
obligations.applicabilityText: Every principal employer, in case employment of contract labour is likely to continue for 6 months and 100 or more contract labour are employed

obligations.title: Provision of restroom facility
obligations.description: Ensure that the rest room facilities are extended to contract workers as prescribed in the log sheets column.
obligations.applicabilityText: Every principal employer, in case contract labour are required to halt at night and employment of contract labour is likely to continue for 90 days or more

obligations.title: Storage of pressure vessels
obligations.description: Ensure that all vessels meant for storage are stored as per the specifications provided in the attached log sheet " storage".
obligations.applicabilityText: Every person in charge of vessels meant for storage

obligations.title: White washing of canteen
obligations.description: Ensure that the inside walls of the canteen are lime-washed or colour-washed at least once in each year
obligations.applicabilityText: Every principal employer, in case employment of contract labour is likely to continue for 6 months and 100 or more contract labour are employed

obligations.title: Latrine and Urinal infrastructural facility in the factory premises
obligations.description: Provide latrine and urinal infrastructural facility as referred in additional information.

obligations.title: Earthing of pressure vessels
obligations.description:
Ensure that:
(1) all vessel which is used for storage of flammable compressed gases is electrically connected with the earth in an efficient manner.
(2) pipelines conveying flammable liquids are adequately prepared for electrical continuity and connected with the earth in an efficient manner.
obligations.applicabilityText: Every person incharge of vessels meant for storage

obligations.title: Payment of wages to contracted workers
obligations.description:
Ensure that the contractor pays wages and allowances to the workers.

Refer to log sheet for details of payment of wages to contracted workers

obligations.title: Fragile Roofs – Provision of Crawling Boards, etc.
obligations.description:
Ensure that no person shall be required to stand, walk or do any work or go for any work on or near any roof or ceiling covered with or constructed of sheets of whatever nature made of any material or materials in respect of which there may be danger of the sheet breaking due to the weight of a man or otherwise, and no person shall be required or allowed to work or go for any purpose whatsoever, on as loping roof unless:-
(a) suitable and sufficient ladders, duct ladders or clawing boards, safety belts; safety nets etc. securely supported, are provided and used; 

(b) suitable and sufficient parapet wall or railing or any other equally effective device to prevent the person from falling from the sloping roof is provided.

(c) a notice in bold letters, in a language understood by the majority of the workers warning that the roof is o fragile materials and is dangerous and that no person should go or work on the roof unless full protective measures have been take, is displayed at such a prominent place or places, and in such a manner as to attract immediate attention; and 

(b) a permit to work on the fragile roof is issued to him each time he is required to work thereon by a responsible person of the factory concerned.

obligations.title: Procedure for Management of Hazardous and Other Wastes
obligations.description: Ensure to comply with the responsibilities of the occupier for management of hazardous and other wastes mentioned in the log sheet

obligations.title: Safety Measures
obligations.description:
Ensure that following activities shall not be undertaken so as to cause risk of life or of bodily injury.

(a) Construction of building, wall, chimney, bridge tunnel, road, gallery, stairway, ramp, floor, platform, staging or other structure whether of a permanent or temporary nature.
(b) Construction, operation or installation of machinery, plant or equipment
(c) Method of work
(d) Stacking and storing of materials

obligations.title: Age - Limit of apprentice
obligations.description: Ensure not to engage any person as an apprentice below fourteen years of age and for designated trades related to hazardous industries not below eighteen years of age.

obligations.title: Notify proposed measures
obligations.description: Ensure to register with the Chief Commissioner or the State Commissioner, as the case may be, a copy of the  equal opportunity policy detailing measures proposed to be taken in the manner prescribed by the Central Government.

obligations.title: Requirements relating to training and Staffing Pattern
obligations.description:
Ensure that the :-
(i) Person in charge of the training posses the qualification specified in Schedule IV
(ii) Staffing pattern and qualifications of instructional staff for imparting practical and basic training to apprentices shall be as specified in Schedule IVA.

(Please refer the Log Sheet - Schedule IV and Schedule IVA)

obligations.title: Recruitment policy
obligations.description: Ensure to formulate a policy for recruiting any apprentice who has completed the period of apprenticeship training.

obligations.title: Issuance of wage slip
obligations.description: Issue wage slips to employees in Form XV.

obligations.title: Supervision and Operation within the Licensed premises
obligations.description: Ensure that the operation of the licensed premises is under the supervision of persons having adequate knowledge of the equipment in the premises and trained in handling compressed gas
obligations.applicabilityText: The owner/occupier of the Licensed premises

obligations.title: Protection against fire hazards

obligations.title: Working Hours of Adult
obligations.description:
Ensure that:
(I) No adult worker shall be required or allowed to work in a factory for more than forty-eight hours in any week.
(ii) No adult worker shall be required or allowed to work in a factory for more than nine hours in any day
(iii) The periods of work of adult workers in a factory each day shall be so fixed that no period shall exceed five hours and that no worker shall work for more than five hours before he has had an interval for rest of at least half an hour.
(iv) The periods of work of an adult worker in a factory shall be so arranged that inclusive of his intervals for rest, they shall not spread over more than ten and a half hours in any day
(v) Work shall not be carried on in any factory by me and of a system of shifts so arranged that more than one relay of workers is engaged in work of the same kind at the same time
(vi) No adult worker shall be required or allowed to work in any factory on any day on which he has already been working in any other factory
(vii) No adult worker shall be required or allowed to work in any factory otherwise than in accordance with the notice of periods of work for adults displayed in the factory and the entries made beforehand against his name in the register of adult workers of the factory.

obligations.title: Precautions and preventions
obligations.description:
Ensure to -
(1) Comply with the provisions of these rules and the conditions of any license issued there under;
(2) observe all precautions of the prevention or accident by fire or explosion.
(3) prevent any person working in the premises where compressed gases are stored or used from committing or attempting to commit any act which may tend to cause a fire or explosion.
obligations.applicabilityText: Every person storing compressed gas in a vessel and every person in charge of , or engaged in the storage, handling and transport of such gas in vessels

obligations.title: Filling Capacity and Filling Pressure
obligations.description:
1. Ensure that the maximum quantity of liquefiable gas filled into any vessel is limited to the filling density of the gas and that the vessel is not liquid-full due to expansion of the contents with rise of the temperature to 55dc. 

2. Ensure that no vessel is filled with any permanent gas in excess of its design pressure.

3. Ensure that:
(a) the water capacity of the cryogenic pressure vessel shall be rated in terms of gross water capacity and the allowable water capacity in litres at 15°C. 
(b) the usable water capacity shall not exceed 95% of the gross water capacity. 
(c) an overflow pipe shall be provided at the maximum allowable capacity level as a safeguard against filling the vessel beyond the maximum usable capacity.

obligations.title: Production of license on demand
obligations.description:
Produce the licence or its authenticated copy when called upon to do so by any of the following officers:
(1) The Chief Controller or Controller authorised by Chief Controller;
(2) All District Magistrates
(3) All Magistrates subordinate to the District Magistrate. 
(4) The Commissioners of Police
(5) Deputy Commissioners of Police subordinate to the Commissioners of Police;
(6) All police officers not below the rank of 3 Sub-Inspector.
